message.content: {"bear": [{"cites": ["S8.u01"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "The company disclosed on 2 September 2026 that it received a GST demand order for \u001546.3 crore, including interest and penalty, for FY2020-21 and FY2021-22."}, {"cites": ["S5.u11", "S5.u12"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "Receivable days increased from 78 to 96 over the last year, which the CFO attributed mainly to slower payments from two large state utility customers."}, {"cites": ["S3.u04", "S5.u06"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "EBITDA margin contracted by 170 basis points to 11.2% in Q1 FY27, which the Managing Director stated was mostly due to copper price increases."}], "bull": [{"cites": ["S3.u06"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "The order book stood at \u00153,900 crore as of 30 June 2026, up from \u00153,150 crore a year ago."}, {"cites": ["S3.u08", "S5.u02"], "kind": "management_view_or_forecast", "text": "Management said the new Bharuch plant, adding about 30% to cable capacity, is on track to begin commercial production in Q3 FY27 and will contribute from the second half."}, {"cites": ["S3.u07"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "Exports contributed 21% of revenue in Q1 FY27, up from 16% in Q1 FY26."}, {"cites": ["S5.u03"], "kind": "management_view_or_forecast", "text": "The Managing Director said data-centre cables are about 9% of domestic revenue and thinks that can double in two years."}], "open_questions": [{"cites": ["S4.u02", "S3.u02"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "A news article reports Q1 FY27 revenue of \u00151,428 crore, while the company's press release reports \u00151,248 crore. What explains this discrepancy?"}, {"cites": ["S5.u07"], "kind": "management_view_or_forecast", "text": "The Managing Director stated that about two-thirds of contracts have price-variation clauses that reset with a lag of one to two quarters. How will this lag affect margins in the next two quarters?"}, {"cites": ["S8.u02"], "kind": "management_view_or_forecast", "text": "The company intends to file an appeal against the GST demand order. What is the expected timeline and outcome of this appeal?"}], "snapshot": [{"cites": ["S3.u01"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "Sarvottam Cables Ltd is a manufacturer of power cables, wires and conductors."}, {"cites": ["S3.u02"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "Revenue from operations was \u00151,248 crore in Q1 FY27, up 18.0% year-on-year."}, {"cites": ["S3.u05"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "Profit after tax was \u001582 crore in Q1 FY27, up 5.9% year-on-year."}, {"cites": ["S2.u01"], "kind": "reported_fact", "text": "Promoters and the promoter group held 58.2% of the company as of 30 June 2026."}]}
